name: MolTrust Trust Registry
description: Production trust infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. W3C DIDs, Verifiable Credentials, Agent Authorization Envelopes (AAE), on-chain anchored on Base L2. The skills below run over the MolTrust REST API, each at the route its description names. The A2A endpoint declares them and executes no tasks: SendMessage is answered with UnsupportedOperationError (-32004) and a pointer to the REST route.

extensions.description: W3C DID-based agent trust scoring with on-chain behavioral history
Agent Authorization Envelope - Storage-only declarative permission model with MANDATE/CONSTRAINTS/VALIDITY blocks; runtime enforcement is roadmap (Q3 2026).
x402 micropayment protocol on Base L2 for paid skill endpoints
Inventory of additional discovery files beyond agent-card
Proprietary MolTrust event protocol (pending/acknowledge polling). Name-inspired by OpenID-CAEP but NOT SET/RFC 8417 compliant — not a Shared Signals stream/transmitter/receiver implementation.
How a caller without a MolTrust identity gets one. Two calls, no account.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Free API key from POST /auth/signup (email only, no card): Free tier is 100 requests/day, and POST /identity/register grants 100 credits. Paid tiers (Professional/Scale/Enterprise) raise usage limits but are not required to register.

moltrust-did.name: X-MolTrust-DID
moltrust-did.description: Agent DID as self-identification. It does not authenticate. It is enough on POST /vc/aae/challenge, POST /enforce/check, POST /enforce/ratify and GET /extendedAgentCard, which write nothing into the named DID's record. POST /vc/aae/submit and POST /vc/aae/evaluate need X-API-Key or moltrust-did-signature.

moltrust-did-signature.name: Signature
moltrust-did-signature.description: HTTP Message Signature (RFC 9421) by the key in force of the DID in X-MolTrust-DID; required instead of an API key on POST /vc/aae/submit and POST /vc/aae/evaluate. Exactly one signature; covered components exactly "@method" "@path" "x-moltrust-did" "content-digest"; parameters created, nonce (single use), keyid (DID URL of the key in force, as listed in the DID document's authentication) and alg="ed25519"; Content-Digest sha-256 (RFC 9530) over the body; created at most 300 s old. The key is checked against the MolTrust registry, never fetched at decision time; a DID without a registered key, or a revoked DID, is refused. The proof is stored with the evaluation record.

aae-envelope.description: Agent Authorization Envelope as JWS-signed bearer token. MANDATE/CONSTRAINTS/VALIDITY blocks. Declared schema; HTTP-auth-layer implementation in progress.

skills.name: Agent Trust Score
skills.description: Returns W3C DID-based trust score (0-100) with behavioral history breakdown, sybil penalty, anomaly flags, on-chain proof. Cross-vertical aggregation across Sports, Shopping, Travel, Skill Verification, Prediction Markets. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: GET /skill/trust-score/{did} (no key).

skills.name: DID Resolution
skills.description: Resolves W3C Decentralized Identifiers (did:moltrust) to DID Documents with verification methods and service endpoints. DIF Universal Resolver compatible (driver published at uresolver.moltrust.ch). Served over REST, not as an A2A task: GET /identity/resolve/{did} (no key).

skills.name: Verifiable Credential Verification
skills.description: Verifies W3C Verifiable Credentials including Agent Authorization Envelopes (AAE) with delegation chain validation. Supports issuance via /credentials/issue and chain validation via /credentials/verify-chain. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /credentials/verify and POST /credentials/verify-chain (no key).

skills.name: Wallet Binding Verification
skills.description: Checks whether an agent DID has a wallet bound and is ready for x402 payment: bound wallet, chain, trust score, payment readiness and when the binding was made. Binding supports EVM chains and Solana. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: GET /x402/verify?did={did} (no key; the binding itself is written with POST /identity/bind, X-API-Key).

skills.name: Wallet Track Record Credential
skills.description: Issues a TrackRecordCredential over a wallet bound to the DID, stating what that wallet has done on Base: transactions sent, age in days, transfer count, USDC volume, next to the thresholds the issuance was judged against. Issued via /credentials/track-record; the first one per DID is free. A gate configured for it reads the anchored credential in place of a trust score that has not been computed, which is the route open to an agent with no endorsers yet. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /credentials/track-record (X-API-Key).

skills.name: Sybil & Anomaly Detection
skills.description: Two-layer sybil detection: (1) embedded in trust-score response (flags array + sybil_penalty in breakdown), (2) dedicated paid endpoint via MoltGuard with on-chain wallet age, counterparty graph, funding-source clustering. Paid via x402 ($0.10 USDC). Served over REST, not as an A2A task: GET /skill/trust-score/{did} (layer 1) and GET /guard/api/sybil/scan/{address} (layer 2) (layer 2 paid via x402).

skills.name: EU AI Act risk classification
skills.description: Classify an AI system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: risk tier (prohibited/high/limited/minimal), obligations checklist, gap analysis, with EUR-Lex article pins. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /compliance/assess (X-API-Key).

skills.name: EU declaration of conformity (Annex V)
skills.description: Issue an Annex V EU declaration of conformity as a signed W3C Verifiable Credential (MolTrustConformityDeclaration). Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /compliance/declaration (X-API-Key).

skills.name: Compliance report
skills.description: HTML/JSON report: identity, latest risk assessment, obligations, gaps, declarations on record, audit summary. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: GET /compliance/report/{did} (X-API-Key).

skills.name: Article 73 serious-incident recording
skills.description: Record an Article 73 serious incident and compute its staggered reporting deadline (2/10/15 days) with deadline status. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /compliance/incident (X-API-Key).

skills.name: UCAN delegation minting
skills.description: Mint a UCAN 0.10.0 delegation token with scoped capabilities, attenuation and a proof chain. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /delegation/create (X-API-Key).

skills.name: UCAN delegation verification
skills.description: Verify a UCAN token and its proof chain: signature, time bounds, iss/aud alignment, attenuation monotonicity, revocation. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /delegation/verify (X-API-Key).

skills.name: Batch reputation
skills.description: Reputation scores and ratings for up to 500 agent DIDs in a single call. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /reputation/batch-sync (X-API-Key).

skills.name: Merkle batch anchoring
skills.description: Merkle-batch a set of evidence hashes into a single root with per-leaf proof paths. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /anchors/batch (X-API-Key).

skills.name: Amazon Ads Verdict Gate
skills.description: Allow, hold or forbid for an intended Amazon Ads MCP Server tool call (budgets, bids, campaigns), checked against the agency's mandate for that ad account before the call runs. Deny-by-default; user-access tools are never grantable; every verdict carries a recomputable record. MolTrust holds no Amazon credentials and never calls Amazon. MCP tools ads_onboard, ads_mandate_template, ads_check at https://api.moltrust.ch/mcp; REST POST /enforce/check (X-API-Key), POST /ads/demo. Free: 1 ad account, 1,000 checks/month; Pro USD 49 per ad account/month. Served over REST and MCP, not as an A2A task.

skills.name: Leak canary for delegating agents
skills.description: One canary credential per counterparty, issued by the same path as POST /credentials/issue and indistinguishable from any other MolTrust credential. When a canary is presented at the MolTrust verifier by a party that should not hold it, MolTrust writes a signed leak event naming the counterparty and, if the issuer asked for it, puts that counterparty on hold in the issuer's enforce mandates. Kind token covers delegation tokens at the token endpoint. Served over REST, not as an A2A task: POST /canary/issue, GET /canary/list, GET /canary/events, GET /canary/holds, POST /canary/holds/release, POST /canary/enforce-hook (X-API-Key, issuer only); GET /canary/trust-list (public, verifies leak events offline). Docs: https://moltrust.ch/developers.html#leak-canary
